newsitem.title: CANADA: Saskatchewan Wheat adds big elevators.
newsitem.headline: Saskatchewan Wheat adds big elevators.

text.p: Saskatchewn Wheat Pool said on Wednesday it was adding six more large capacity grain elevators to its existing network of 219.
"Declining trade barriers are enhancing our ability to satisfy global demand for our products," the company said in a statement.
The elevators, known as high throughput elevators, have a holding capacity ranging from 10,000 to 26,000 tonnes compared to wood elevators that hold from 5,000 to 12,000 tonnes.
Saskatchewan Wheat Pool is Canada's largest grain handler with revenues of C$4.1 billion in fiscal 1996.
The firm had a 57 percent share of the grain handling market in Saskatchewan, the statement said.
The company had 219 of Saskatchewan's 306 high throughput elevators.
